paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of Average Lagging (AL) for four different models, comparing their performance across varying levels of lagging. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) and is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, also on a linear scale, ranging from 12 to 28, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The plot contains four distinct lines: the “Consistency-CE” model is shown as a light purple dashed line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 13 at AL=0 and increasing to about 26.5 at AL=6. The “Inconsistency-CE” model is depicted as a dark purple solid line with square markers, beginning at a BLEU score of about 20 at AL=0 and rising to approximately 27.5 at AL=6. The “Inconsistency-CE-MP” model is represented by a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of roughly 19.5 at AL=0 and increasing to around 27 at AL=6. Finally, the “Consistency-Bi” model is shown as a red solid line with star markers, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 22.5 at AL=0 and steadily increasing to about 28 at AL=6.
